Upstream requirements:

⌈

.
transfor-
mationProps
.
sizeOfArrayLengthField
defines the data type for the length field
of a array, the data shall be:
•
std::uint8

sizeOfArrayLengthField
equals 1
•
std::uint16

equals 2
